newsitem.title: USA: Stride Rite says Q1 helped by Hilfiger line.
newsitem.headline: Stride Rite says Q1 helped by Hilfiger line.

text.p: Stride Rite Corp said Tuesday that first quarter results were helped by the introduction of Tommy Hilfiger Corp's footwear line.
Stride Rite said in a release that the initial consumer response to the Tommy Hilfiger product line "exceeded everyone's expectations and retailer response" to the footwear line for the Fall season.

The company said Spring orders for the Tommy Hilfiger line were delivered at a 99.6 percent completion rate, providing retailers with product and point of purchase displays prior to the official launch date of February 1, 1997.
The company reported first quarter 1997 income of $4.12 million, or $0.08 per share, compared to $1.38 million, or $0.03 per share, for the same period last year.
It said it continues to be "encouraged by (its) prospects for the remainder of fiscal 1997."
